derived_results.claim: Analytically proved p_theta/p_rho <= [2/(1-rho)](u/ell)^m exp(m h^2/(2u^2)); for rho<=0.56 this is <=461.24628.

All omitted |ybar|>h+u/sqrt(m) contribution to C_mumu is nonnegative. The only possible negative W-tail is bounded by M m/ell^2 P_q(W>R); W/4 is exactly BetaPrime(31/2,3), giving penalty <=0.09809 at R=2000 for rho<=0.56.

The log-scale second-derivative kernel is nonnegative above z_+=m+1+sqrt(2m+1). Hence outside |ybar|<=1.32301839,W<=47.40966879 the contribution to C_tt is nonnegative for every null parameter, yielding a fixed compact lower integral with zero tail error.

Deterministic engineering quadrature after compactification gave minima about 30.80 for the compact C_mumu integral (before <=0.0981 tail penalty) and 19.605 for the tail-free compact C_tt integral. These are not interval-certified, but the proof target now has large numerical slack.
